text_block_list.text:
At dusk, while peering into shops wondering what to have for dinner,
I ran into Mr. C.B. and her parents.

text_block_list.name: C.B.'s Mother
text_block_list.text: Thank you for looking after my girl. I never imagined we would run into each other in a place like this.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
We're having dinner as a family in a bit.
Mom was super eager to make a hot pot.

text_block_list.name: C.B.'s Father
text_block_list.text:
If you'd like, why don't you join us, Trainer?
I'd love to hear about how my daughter is doing at the academy.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... Looks like Dad wants someone to have a drink with him.
Would you mind joining him if it's alright?
And so, on short notice, I was invited to have a meal with Mr. C.B. and her parents.

"While her parents prepared dinner,
I took up her offer to go on a stroll.
I wondered if I should have helped them, though."

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
No prob, no prob. Wouldn't want to get in the way
of your quality time together as a married couple, right?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
My parents are still totally lovey-dovey.
...Did I ever tell you they used to be
a Trainer and Umamusume duo?

Her father was apparently a legendary Trainer
whose name will go down in Umamusume history.

"His Umamusume seemed to gallop across the heavens"
—to the extent that such legends were told.

And her mother was a famous Umamusume who had won graded stakes.
To think that the two of them would end up together...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Back when Dad was still a rookie Trainer,
he met Mom... and it was love at first sight, apparently.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Still, this is where it gets really amazing!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Her family was fiercely opposed to it—so they ended up practically eloping to get married.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I was so shocked when I first heard.
To think running away for love was a real thing.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
That's why those two are still lovey-dovey to this day.
It's almost embarrassing to watch.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: I love my mom and dad so much.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Because the two of you followed your hearts, I'm here right now. And I'm sure that was a future without regrets.
choice_data_list: ...I see, you're really cherished, aren't you.

text_block_list.name: C.B.'s Father
text_block_list.text:
"I'm sorry to make you pour for me as well.
Especially when you're always taking such good care of my daughter, Trainer-san."

text_block_list.name: C.B.'s Mother
text_block_list.text:
Yes, indeed. I had always been praying
that my daughter would meet a wonderful
Trainer someday, you know?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Does that mean... like Mom and Dad?
Just kidding! Ahaha.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: I love my mom and dad so much.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Because the two of you followed your hearts, I'm here right now. And I'm sure that was a future without regrets.

"Her parents truly love their daughter.
That's precisely why I feel the heavy responsibility
of being her Trainer."
Unable to bend her own ways, she has clashed with others time and time again in the past. And the ones who watched over her closer than anyone else must have been her parents.

Mr. C.B. is going to be fine now.
As her Trainer, that's what I wanted to tell you.
choice_data_list: I will definitely make her shine.
Please come watch my race again next time.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Trainer...? What's wrong?
Why are you bowing your head like that?

text_block_list.name: C.B.'s Father
text_block_list.text:
...Haha. Indeed, taking on an Umamusume
requires a commensurate amount of resolve, after all.

text_block_list.name: C.B.'s Mother
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, how nostalgic.
Somehow, they remind me of how you used to be.

text_block_list.name: C.B.'s Parents
text_block_list.text: Please, take good care of our daughter.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Huh... B-Both of you too?!
What happened to you guys? Why are you being so formal all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Geez, this is embarrassing...
...It's not like we're on a matchmaking date, you know?
"I will support her with everything I have so I don't let her parents down. That was the vow I made in my heart."

"As her Trainer, I promise I'll let you see her run
freely in a race that's truly her own. When I told them that..."

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Come on, don't say that now. It's thanks to you
that I'm able to run just the way I want.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Come on, don't say that now. It's thanks to you
that I'm able to run just the way I want.

text_block_list.name: C.B.'s Mother
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, but I understand how Trainer feels too.
Right, darling?

text_block_list.name: C.B.'s Father
text_block_list.text:
"...Yeah, you're right. Understood,
I'll come watch your race again sometime."

"To put her parents' minds at ease, I have to show
that I'm a Trainer worthy of her...!"
